text: I think the main reason is convenience. You can buy things at any time from your sofa, and you don't need to carry heavy bags. Also, prices are often lower online, and there are more choices. But there are some problems, for example the product can be different from the photo. Personally, I still prefer shopping in a real shop for clothes, because I want to try them on.

tips.en: Set opening phrases (In my opinion, I'd say) sound natural in spoken answers.
tips.kk: Тұрақты кіріспе тіркестер (In my opinion, I'd say) ауызша сөйлеуде табиғи естіледі.
tips.ru: Устойчивые вводные формулы (In my opinion, I'd say) звучат естественно в устной речи.
tips.example: I think the main reason is convenience

tips.en: Contrast words (but, however, whereas) show that you can see both sides of the issue.
tips.kk: Қарама-қарсы байламдар (but, however, whereas) мәселенің екі жағын көргеніңізді көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Слова контраста (but, however, whereas) показывают, что вы видите обе стороны вопроса.

text: Not always. If children play for too long, they can become tired and lose interest in school. However, some games help them think quickly and work with other players. I think the main thing is time. Parents should make rules, for example one hour a day, and children should also have other hobbies like sport or reading. When there is a balance, games are not a big problem.

tips.en: Conditional structures (if, otherwise, once) add complexity and precision.
tips.kk: Шартты құрылымдар (if, otherwise, once) жауапты күрделі әрі нақты етеді.
tips.ru: Условные конструкции (if, otherwise, once) добавляют сложность и точность.
tips.example: If children play for too long

tips.en: Contrast words (but, however, whereas) show that you can see both sides of the issue.
tips.kk: Қарама-қарсы байламдар (but, however, whereas) мәселенің екі жағын көргеніңізді көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Слова контраста (but, however, whereas) показывают, что вы видите обе стороны вопроса.

text: In the past, people went to the cinema or watched films on TV at fixed times. Now they can watch anything on their phones or laptops, whenever they want. This is more comfortable and cheaper, but I think we lose something. The cinema is a special experience because you watch with other people and the screen is huge. So I think cinemas will stay, but fewer people will go.

tips.en: Comparative structures show how something has changed over time.
tips.kk: Салыстырмалы құрылымдар бір нәрсенің уақыт өте қалай өзгергенін көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Сравнительные конструкции помогают показать, как что-то изменилось со временем.
tips.example: In the past, people went to the cinema

tips.en: Accurate future forms (will, may, could) show grammatical range when predicting.
tips.kk: Келер шақ формалары (will, may, could) болжам жасағанда грамматикалық ауқымды көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Верные формы будущего (will, may, could) показывают грамматический диапазон при прогнозах.
tips.example: cinemas will stay, but fewer people will go

questions.question: How has the way people watch films changed?

text: Sometimes it is useful, for example when you want to understand a word the doctor used. But I don't think it is safe to trust everything you read. Many websites are not written by doctors, and the information can be wrong or too general. I know a person who was very afraid after reading about a small headache. So I think the internet is fine for basic information, but for serious problems you must see a doctor.

tips.en: Hedging language sounds natural and avoids over-categorical claims.
tips.kk: Жұмсартатын сөздер табиғи естіледі, пікірді тым қатаң етпейді.
tips.ru: Смягчающие выражения звучат естественно и не делают утверждение слишком категоричным.
